candidate_rule: >=3 unique UTC days AND >=2 unique VIIRS sensors AND >=1 high-confidence observation AND last observation within 72h of the 2026-10-14T03:14:55Z export analysis time
peat_meaning: count of VIIRS centroids inside supplied 1:50,000 peat-soil map units; not an areal peat fraction nor measured peat fire
worldcover_meaning: ESA WorldCover 2021 10m 11-class valid area fractions. Available for 12 1km pilot cells ONLY.
not_claimed: Not realtime or continuously refreshing; not independent fire incidents; no validated fire risk ranking; no burned area
provenance: NASA FIRMS ZIP uploaded by user; gambut overlays from source uploaded by user; WC 1km pilot uploaded by user
